fusions.name: Rust Bloom
fusions.desc: A wet slap that deals 4 damage and rusts the target's armour, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 8 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Breaching Hull
fusions.desc: Breaches and comes down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Barnacled Plating
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Laminate Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
